column1: # Rule: a table header [a.b] is a package named by its dotted path, without
# the brackets and without white space around the dots; a quoted segment keeps
# its quotes. Not definitions: keys, inline tables, values, arrays of tables
# ([[a]], repeated by construction), and the sections every manifest has
# (package, lib, workspace, features, build-system, project, any *dependencies).
# Narrow because a key is a setting (the config analyser already reports them)
# and manifest boilerplate would repeat once per crate or project.
